wiki.title: Harriet Hageman
wiki.extract: Harriet Maxine Hageman (born October 18, 1962) is an American politician and attorney who is the United States senator-elect from Wyoming. Since 2023, she has served as the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district.
